question: Is non-discrimination only bondage or also a means to liberation?
premises: It is commonly said that non-discrimination is supreme bondage.
That common saying is only a partial report.
Non-discrimination itself can become the supreme stairway to gaining liberation.
inference: Non-discrimination is not merely bondage; rightly understood, it can serve as the path to liberation.
plain_english: To say that non-discrimination is supreme bondage is only a common saying; for non-discrimination itself can be the supreme stairway to attaining liberation.
